notes.title: Version 1.0 Update
notes.content:
[olist]
Optimized Game Content

Greatly improved the game's frame rate for a smoother gaming experience.

Fixed Partial Bugs

Addressed and resolved some in-game bugs.

Added Language Support

Included support for Russian, German, Italian, and Spanish.
[/olist]
       The game was developed by one person, so please be more understanding. If you encounter any issues, feel free to provide feedback and I will gradually make improvements.
